title: SemantiScene-Edit: Expert-Synthesized Supervision and Dual-Path Source Conditioning for Instruction-Based Video Editing
abstract: arXiv:2609.26015v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Instruction-guided video editing requires executing a requested change while preserving the source video's appearance and temporal structure. We present SemantiScene-Edit, a video editor that couples a multimodal encoder with a pretrained video diffusion transformer. The encoder jointly processes source frames and the editing instruction, and learnable queries convey their semantic context to the generator through a trainable connector and cross-attention. A complementary visual pathway concatenates source-video latents with noisy target latents before patch embedding, supplying dense spatial and temporal information for content preservation. We train the model with flow matching and a three-stage image--video curriculum comprising semantic alignment, joint adaptation, and high-resolution refinement. translated_title: SemantiScene-Edit：基于专家合成监督与双路源条件化的指令式视频编辑
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.26015v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：指令引导的视频编辑要求在保留源视频外观和时序结构的同时执行所请求的修改。我们提出了SemantiScene-Edit，这是一个将多模态编码器与预训练视频扩散Transformer相结合的视频编辑器。该编码器联合处理源视频帧和编辑指令，并通过可训练连接器与交叉注意力将二者的语义上下文传递给生成器。一条互补的视觉通路在块嵌入（patch embedding）之前将源视频潜变量与含噪目标潜变量拼接，为内容保留提供密集的空间与时间信息。我们采用流匹配以及包含语义对齐、联合适配和高分辨率精炼的三阶段图像-视频课程训练策略来训练模型。为支持训练，我们构建了超过120万条涵盖物体添加、移除、替换等操作的指令条件化视频编辑记录，这些记录由专家合成监督数据构成。
tldr: 提出SemantiScene-Edit，一种将多模态编码器与预训练视频扩散Transformer结合的指令式视频编辑方法，通过语义与视觉双路源条件化机制及120万条专家合成的训练数据，在精确执行编辑指令的同时保留源视频的外观与时序结构。
en_tdlr: SemantiScene-Edit couples a multimodal encoder with a pretrained video diffusion transformer, leveraging dual-path source conditioning (semantic and visual pathways) and 1.2 million expert-synthesized instruction-editing records to execute instructed edits while preserving the source video's appearance and temporal structure.
